group.name: How the new models are applied

plugin.name: No ESP (SkyPatcher)
plugin.description: No plugin. SkyPatcher swaps the models when the game starts, on every copy of each Nordic carved weapon - including copies other mods add - and leaves every other change those mods make to the weapons alone. Needs SkyPatcher.

plugin.name: ESP
plugin.description: A light plugin (ESL-flagged, takes no load order slot) that sets the models on the Dragonborn Nordic carved weapons and their enchanted versions. No SkyPatcher needed. It carries the weapons' vanilla records, so load it before any mod that changes these weapons' stats, or that mod's changes are undone.

plugin.name: Six-flanged mace (default)
plugin.description: A functional six-flanged mace head, a beast's biting maw carved on every flange face.

plugin.name: Classic mace
plugin.description: The vanilla mace's four-flanged shape, rebuilt and carved with the same biting maw.
